analysis.title: GS Early Morning Research Recap: Ratings and Target Price Changes - November 3, 2026 as of 5:30 AM ET
key_insights: Goldman's focus calls for the day: a Global Markets Comment on the Fed as a driver of long-term rates (Wilson), and a GOAL Kickstart (Mueller-Glissmann) titled 'Tech wreck - rotation out of AI stocks continues into midterm elections'.

Rating changes: SIRI upgraded to Buy from Neutral. Goldman's note cites improving risk/reward from durable core satellite trends, ramping YouTube monetization, and potential spectrum value unlock. Target raised to $37 from $33, 25% upside from $29.57.

Six China/HK airline names were cut in the Higher jet fuel note: Air China (601111.SS, 0753.HK) to Sell from Buy, China Southern (600029.SS to Sell from Neutral, 1055.HK to Sell from Buy), China Eastern (600115.SS, 0670.HK) to Neutral from Buy. Targets were cut 20-50%.
Goldman's China airlines note says higher jet fuel will weigh for longer, though a supply shortage sustains the sector.

Target changes of 10% or more among US names: VRTX to $725 from $654 (Buy), SIRI to $37 from $33 (Buy), FLNC to $7 from $9 (Neutral), TYL to $385 from $345 (Neutral, -5% downside), MAR to $456 from $406 (Buy).
Brokers & Crypto (Yaro) reviews the recent Binance cybersecurity incident and potential ramifications for Goldman's coverage. The recap carries no detail on the incident.
Apple F4Q26 review: iPhone and Mac beat demonstrate pricing power and a refresh opportunity, while memory and inference costs weigh on the outlook.
Marvell announced a definitive agreement to acquire Lumentum (Goldman's note dated Nov 2).
Vertex 3Q report was solid, with IgAN approval the focus into an eventful 4Q and beyond. Target raised to $725.
Moderna 3Q preview: after the Phase 3 melanoma win, focus shifts to RCC and the platform.

Estee Lauder: Goldman sees a strong start to FY27 setting up a multi-year beat and raise cycle (reiterate Buy). Clorox: Goldman keeps Sell because the FQ1 beat was aided by transitory factors and cost pressures weigh on FQ2 and FY27 EPS.
Utilities: Xcel (XEL, Buy) raised capex and growth outlook, with Goldman seeing peer-leading 10% EPS CAGR through 2031. Exelon (EXC) and WEC stay Sell.
Fox Corp F1Q27: EBITDA beat driven by the World Cup and political ads, with continued momentum in Tubi.
nVent (NVT) reported a 3Q beat and raise with record orders. Ingersoll Rand (IR) estimates raised on order strength.

Housing: GS Housing Market Activity Scale was flat sequentially for the week of Oct 25 while the September monthly reading declined 4%. Homebuilder note cites weaker demand with mortgage rates in the mid-7% range.
Europe: Essity and Magnum Ice Cream are Sell. Philips posted strong order intake and a margin beat. Lufthansa Q3 EBIT beat, but the top end of guidance was reduced.
Upcoming events: US Midterm Elections first-take webinar November 4 at 8 AM ET; Election Post-Mortem November 4 at 11:30 AM ET.
